_comment: Kit bundles shown as 'add all to cart' on component product pages (lib/catalog/bundles.ts). Components mirror docs/catalog-expansion/toyota-service-kits-batch-*.json. A bundle appears only when approved is true AND every component is a published, purchasable listing. Set approved only on the owner's approval.

bundles.name: Camry 2020–2024 2.5L Filter & Spark Plug Kit
bundles.summary: Spin-on oil filter, engine air filter, charcoal cabin air filter and a full set of four iridium spark plugs for the 2.5L four-cylinder gas Camry.
bundles.notIncluded: Engine oil and the oil drain plug gasket are not included.

bundles.name: RAV4 2019–2023 2.5L Filter & Spark Plug Kit
bundles.summary: Spin-on oil filter, engine air filter and a full set of four iridium spark plugs for the 2.5L gas RAV4.
bundles.notIncluded: Engine oil, the cabin air filter and the oil drain plug gasket are not included. 2024 is not covered: the air filter's 2024 RAV4 fitment is unconfirmed.

bundles.name: Tacoma 2016–2023 3.5L V6 Filter & Spark Plug Kit
bundles.summary: Oil filter element, engine air filter and a full set of six iridium spark plugs (Toyota FK20HBR8) for the 3.5L V6 Tacoma.
bundles.notIncluded: Engine oil, the cabin air filter, the oil drain plug gasket and the oil filter housing O-ring are not included.

bundles.name: Tacoma 2016–2023 2.7L Air Filter & Spark Plug Kit
bundles.summary: Engine air filter and a full set of four iridium spark plugs (Toyota FK20HR-A8) for the 2.7L four-cylinder Tacoma.
bundles.notIncluded: The oil filter is not included (Toyota lists 90915-YZZD1 through 2020 and 90915-YZZG2 from 2021); engine oil and the cabin air filter are not included.

bundles.name: Corolla 2009–2015 1.8L Oil Filter & Spark Plug Kit
bundles.summary: Cartridge oil filter element and a full set of four iridium spark plugs for the 1.8L Corolla.
bundles.notIncluded: Engine oil, the air and cabin filters, the drain plug gasket and the oil filter housing O-ring are not included.

bundles.name: Tacoma 2016–2023 Front Brake Kit — Pads & Rotors
bundles.summary: One front brake pad set (both sides) and two front rotors, for a complete front-axle pad and rotor replacement.
bundles.notIncluded: Pad fitting hardware, brake fluid and wheel hardware are not included.

bundles.name: Camry 2023–2024 Front Brake Kit — Pads & Rotors (US-built, without TRD)
bundles.summary: One front brake pad set and two front rotors for US-built Camrys produced from 02/2023, without the TRD package.
bundles.notIncluded: Pad fitting hardware and brake fluid are not included.

bundles.name: Genuine Toyota Oil Filter Element 04152-YZZA1 — 5-Pack
bundles.summary: Five genuine Toyota 04152-YZZA1 cartridge oil filter elements.
bundles.notIncluded: Housing O-rings and drain plug gaskets are not included.

bundles.name: Genuine Toyota Oil Filter 90915-YZZN1 — 5-Pack
bundles.summary: Five genuine Toyota 90915-YZZN1 spin-on oil filters.
bundles.notIncluded: Drain plug gaskets are not included.
